Manually initiate a payment for a subscription.

**Authentication.** Merchant `bearerAuth` only — the route is
guarded by `merchantMiddleware.verifyMerchantToken`
(`route/subscriptionRoute.js:74-80`). The subscription-service
dispatcher uses a different entry path that performs `Ref-App-Key`
validation via `subscriptionMiddleware.verifySubscriptionServiceRequest`;
that path is not this operation.
